flowless_commands.menu: The terminal renderer opens its menu itself; the command never reaches core.
flowless_commands.settings: The terminal renderer opens its Settings screen itself; the command never reaches core.
flowless_commands.quit: Quit ends the terminal loop before any flow runs.

scenarios.name: restore_solved_keep
scenarios.summary: Restoring a solved game and keeping it continues the file: the next autosave writes it without asking.

scenarios.name: restore_solved_new_game
scenarios.summary: Restoring a solved game and starting a new one detaches the file: the next autosave asks before overwriting it.

scenarios.name: auto_save_toggle_then_autosave
scenarios.summary: Turning Auto Save on persists the setting; the next move writes the default file without asking and makes it the current file.

scenarios.name: restore_unsolved_moves
scenarios.summary: Restoring an unfinished game brings back the player's moves and their undo history without asking.

scenarios.name: autosave_then_relaunch_restores_moves
scenarios.summary: Moves autosaved with Auto Save on come back on the next launch: givens stay givens, the player's moves stay moves, an undone move stays undone, and both Undo and Redo are still offered.

scenarios.name: history_branch_discards_redo
scenarios.summary: A move after Undo discards the undone branch: Redo is no longer offered and the undone move stays gone.

scenarios.name: paste_valid_resets_history
scenarios.summary: Pasting a valid puzzle replaces the board with new givens and clears undo history.

scenarios.name: paste_invalid_keeps_board
scenarios.summary: Pasting an invalid line shows an error and leaves the board and undo history as they were.

scenarios.name: settings_change_does_not_autosave
scenarios.summary: With Auto Save on, View and Settings changes persist the settings but never write the game file.

scenarios.name: hint_reports_and_autosaves
scenarios.summary: A hint shows its text in the status line, leaves the hinted cell empty, and autosaves like any other command.

scenarios.name: solve_then_rejected_fill
scenarios.summary: Solve fills the board, reports the win and autosaves; a move on a given cell is then rejected with an error and changes and writes nothing.

scenarios.name: open_then_move_continues_file
scenarios.summary: Opening a saved game with Auto Save on continues that file: the load and the next move both write it without asking.

scenarios.name: import_starts_unsaved_game
scenarios.summary: Importing a puzzle file with Auto Save on makes its line the givens and autosaves to the default file.

scenarios.name: import_invalid_keeps_board
scenarios.summary: Importing a file that is not a puzzle shows one error and leaves the board and its history alone.

scenarios.name: save_names_default_then_continues
scenarios.summary: With Auto Save off, the first Save names the default file and writes it without asking; the next Save continues that file.

scenarios.name: copy_reports_and_writes_nothing
scenarios.summary: Copy hands the puzzle over, reports it, and writes no file even with Auto Save on.

scenarios.name: new_after_open_asks_before_replacing
scenarios.summary: New after Open replaces the board and detaches the opened file: the next autosave asks before overwriting it.

scenarios.name: export_names_default_and_reports
scenarios.summary: Export writes the puzzle text to the default export file and reports it; the game file is only written by autosave.

scenarios.name: startup_idle
scenarios.summary: With nothing to restore and Auto New off, startup shows the empty board and its idle status.

scenarios.name: startup_new_game
scenarios.summary: With Auto New on and nothing to restore, startup generates a new game at the configured difficulty.

scenarios.name: startup_generation_failed
scenarios.summary: When startup's generation fails, core shows its error and the empty board.

not_on.native: Terminal generation always produces a puzzle and has no cancel.

scenarios.name: startup_restore_failed_delete
scenarios.summary: A current file that is no saved game: startup shows the empty board, asks, and deletes it on Delete.

scenarios.name: startup_restore_failed_keep
scenarios.summary: A current file that is no saved game: startup asks, and Keep forgets it without deleting.

scenarios.name: startup_restore_missing
scenarios.summary: A current file that is gone: startup reports the failed restore and asks whether to delete it.

scenarios.name: new_generated
scenarios.summary: New generates a game at the chosen difficulty and replaces the board.

scenarios.name: new_puzzle_line
scenarios.summary: New with a puzzle line typed on the command loads it without generating.

not_on.web: Web and Android New always generates; only the terminal can type a puzzle line.
not_on.android: Web and Android New always generates; only the terminal can type a puzzle line.

scenarios.name: new_cancelled
scenarios.summary: Cancelling generation keeps the board as it was.

not_on.native: Terminal generation always produces a puzzle and has no cancel.

scenarios.name: new_failed
scenarios.summary: A failed generation shows core's error and keeps the board.

not_on.native: Terminal generation always produces a puzzle and has no cancel.

scenarios.name: open_cancelled
scenarios.summary: Backing out of Open's picker changes nothing.

not_on.native: The terminal types the file with the command; there is no picker to cancel.

scenarios.name: open_read_failed
scenarios.summary: A saved game that cannot be read shows core's error and keeps the board.

scenarios.name: open_bad_content
scenarios.summary: A file that is no saved game shows core's error and keeps the board.

scenarios.name: import_cancelled
scenarios.summary: Backing out of Import's picker changes nothing.

not_on.native: The terminal types the file with the command; there is no picker to cancel.

scenarios.name: import_read_failed
scenarios.summary: A puzzle file that cannot be read shows core's error and keeps the board.

scenarios.name: paste_read_failed
scenarios.summary: A clipboard that cannot be read shows core's error and keeps the board.

not_on.native: The terminal has no clipboard: Paste takes its line with the command and Copy prints the puzzle.

scenarios.name: save_bound_file_continues
scenarios.summary: Save after Open writes the opened file without asking.

scenarios.name: save_after_new_on_opened_file_asks
scenarios.summary: After Open then New, Save names the opened file but asks before replacing it; Cancel writes nothing.

scenarios.name: save_default_exists_asks
scenarios.summary: An unbound Save names the default file; when it is already there core asks first, and OK replaces it.

not_on.web: An unbound Save or a Save As opens a picker, which asks its own replace question; core's question is the terminal's.
not_on.android: An unbound Save or a Save As opens a picker, which asks its own replace question; core's question is the terminal's.

scenarios.name: save_default_exists_cancel
scenarios.summary: An unbound Save onto an existing default file: Cancel writes nothing.

not_on.web: An unbound Save or a Save As opens a picker, which asks its own replace question; core's question is the terminal's.
not_on.android: An unbound Save or a Save As opens a picker, which asks its own replace question; core's question is the terminal's.

scenarios.name: save_refused_while_auto_save
scenarios.summary: With Auto Save on, Save is refused with core's message and writes nothing.

not_on.web: The File menu greys Save out while Auto Save is on; only the terminal can type it.
not_on.android: The File menu greys Save out while Auto Save is on; only the terminal can type it.

scenarios.name: save_write_failed
scenarios.summary: A Save whose write fails shows core's error.

scenarios.name: save_as_picked
scenarios.summary: Save As writes the file the player names and makes it the current file.

scenarios.name: save_as_cancelled
scenarios.summary: Backing out of Save As's picker writes nothing.

not_on.native: The terminal types the file with the command; there is no picker to cancel.

scenarios.name: save_as_exists_asks
scenarios.summary: Save As onto a typed path that is already there: core asks first.

not_on.web: An unbound Save or a Save As opens a picker, which asks its own replace question; core's question is the terminal's.
not_on.android: An unbound Save or a Save As opens a picker, which asks its own replace question; core's question is the terminal's.

scenarios.name: save_as_failed
scenarios.summary: A Save As whose write fails shows core's error.

scenarios.name: autosave_default_exists_asks
scenarios.summary: Turning Auto Save on for a new game whose default file is already there: the next move asks before replacing it.

scenarios.name: autosave_default_exists_cancel
scenarios.summary: Declining to replace the existing default file: the move stays and nothing is written.

scenarios.name: autosave_failed
scenarios.summary: An autosave whose write fails shows core's error; the move stays.

scenarios.name: autosave_taken_reclaim
scenarios.summary: Android: the default file belongs to an earlier install; core asks, and picking it lets this install write it again.

not_on.native: Only Android's file bridge reports a file this install may not write (taken).
not_on.web: Only Android's file bridge reports a file this install may not write (taken).

scenarios.name: autosave_taken_save_as
scenarios.summary: Android: the default file belongs to an earlier install; choosing a new name saves the game there.

not_on.native: Only Android's file bridge reports a file this install may not write (taken).
not_on.web: Only Android's file bridge reports a file this install may not write (taken).

scenarios.name: flush_on_close
scenarios.summary: With Auto Save on, closing the app writes the current file once more.

not_on.native: The terminal writes the game after every command; there is no closing write.

scenarios.name: export_cancelled
scenarios.summary: Backing out of Export's picker writes nothing.

not_on.native: The terminal types the file with the command; there is no picker to cancel.

scenarios.name: export_failed
scenarios.summary: An Export whose write fails shows core's error.

scenarios.name: copy_failed
scenarios.summary: A clipboard that cannot be written shows core's error.

not_on.native: The terminal has no clipboard: Paste takes its line with the command and Copy prints the puzzle.

scenarios.name: undo_redo_and_targeted_hint
scenarios.summary: Undo then Redo brings a move back; a hint on a chosen cell reports that cell.

scenarios.name: settings_dialog_changes
scenarios.summary: Each Settings change runs through core and stores the settings.

scenarios.name: settings_persist_failed
scenarios.summary: Settings that cannot be stored show core's error.
